status_definitions.OBSERVED: Field label/structure confirmed in at least one inspected public representation; evidence_method qualifies indexed versus rendered evidence.
status_definitions.NOT_OBSERVED: Explicitly inspected sample with no current-match field; never universal absence.
status_definitions.UNKNOWN: Not evaluated or inconclusive, including loading/error/selected-period ambiguity.
status_definitions.POTENTIAL_MARKET: Derivable settlement or candidate predictive support conditional on future coverage; separate from field status.
